text: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，稳步深化金融改革和对外开放。积极稳妥开展央行间货币互换和本币结算合作。支持和便利更多境外机构参与熊猫债的发行。统筹发展离岸人民币市场，支持上海提升跨境金融、离岸金融服务能力，巩固香港离岸人民币业务枢纽地位。深化跨境贸易和投融资便利化改革。推进人民币跨境支付系统建设，加大跨境支付国际合作力度，完善数字人民币跨境基础设施。
text_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized steadily deepening financial reform and opening up. Active and prudent central bank currency swap and local currency settlement cooperation will be carried out. More overseas institutions will be supported and facilitated to issue panda bonds. Offshore RMB market development will be coordinated, supporting Shanghai in enhancing cross-border and offshore financial service capabilities and consolidating Hong Kong's status as an offshore RMB business hub. Cross-border trade and investment financing facilitation reforms will be deepened. The RMB cross-border payment system will be advanced, cross-border payment international cooperation strengthened, and digital RMB cross-border infrastructure improved.
